screen: /report/<run>#forecast, then trace drawer > Open in Evidence, then browser Back (full)
title: After tracing a figure to Evidence, the browser's Back does not return the reader to that figure: on Forecast the page comes back at scroll 257 instead of 1,101 and the Revenue chart is 1,148 px from the top of a 900 px window, out of sight.
expected: The brief's J3 step 'traces one figure to Evidence and returns to where they were' (docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md, Journeys table); the trace drawer already returns focus to its opener on close (docs/design/react-module-coverage.md:38), so the reader's place is expected to survive the same round trip.
actual: On a 1440 x 900 window the Revenue chart was at scroll 1,101; Open in Evidence landed on Evidence at scroll 257 (the previous page's offset, clamped to Evidence's 1,157 px height, so the page opens part-way down); Back left the page at 257 with the chart 1,148 px below the window top. Same three times in a row. Financial foundation's Leverage chart came back 54 px off (586 to 532, still in view), and an Overview Limitations trace (scroll 2,203) came back at 2,780 in one trial and at 560 in another, so the behaviour is inconsistent: the position is not stored per history entry. The reader scrolls to find the figure again.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-001-back-loses-place.cjs
suggested_change: Store the scroll offset of main per history entry and restore it on Back (or restore focus to the trace control and scroll it into view); reset to top when a trace link opens Evidence.

screen: /start Review and start (second run, same issuer) and /run/<id> (failed)
title: A second run on the same issuer, which the review sheet offers as 'Compared with the Full credit assessment run as of 2025-03-31', fails at once with only 'launcher exited 2; see logs/<id>.log' (a file the browser cannot open), so Changes can never be filled from a real comparison in the proof and the analyst is not told why.
expected: AGENTS.md (CP-8 'runs last in a run with an earlier listed run of the same issuer and pathway' and the Changes page); CT-028 (the review sheet shows the earlier run Changes will use); PRODUCT.md:23 (what a run could not do is stated, not hidden).
actual: The review sheet lists 'Changes since the last run' among the modules and 'Compared with the Full credit assessment run as of 2025-03-31'. After Submit the run page reads 'Failed', 0 of 14 modules, reason 'launcher exited 2; see logs/<id>.log'. /logs/<id>.log and /connected/logs/<id>.log answer 404; the API reason repeats the same line. The real reason is in the launcher log only: 'synthetic proof requires a first Credit Snapshot run' (proof/launcher.py:101). The message is composed at src/deploy_workflow/inbox/runs.py:355. A reader on the J3 journey therefore meets only the empty Changes state ('No earlier run to compare'); the comparison pages exist only in a browser-rewritten fixture.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-002-second-run-fails.cjs
suggested_change: Show the launcher's one-line reason on the failed run page (for example 'The synthetic proof can run a first Credit Snapshot only'), and let the proof complete a second Credit Snapshot with a prior so CP-8 and Changes are exercised, or state on the review sheet that the proof cannot compare.

title: The five headline figure cards on Overview (Net leverage, Gross leverage, Interest coverage, Revenue, Cash) have no trace control, with or without the 'Show sources' switch, so the figures a reader meets first cannot be traced from where they are shown.
expected: AGENTS.md:36-37 and PRODUCT.md:37 ('one trace control per paragraph, row or figure'); docs/design/react-module-coverage.md:38 ('One labelled control per paragraph, row, or figure'); control-matrix CT-047.
actual: Inside the five cards there are 0 buttons or links with the switch off and 0 with it on; clicking the number does nothing. Every other Overview item (bottom line, key findings, contrary evidence, each module row, each limitation) has one. The same values are traceable only after the reader goes to Financial foundation and finds the Leverage chart (whose drawer gives the table caption, not the figure).
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-003-headline-figures-untraceable.cjs
suggested_change: Add one trace control to each headline card that opens the drawer for the table row supplying the value.

title: Evidence > Gaps says 'This run lists no gaps.' while the same run's pages state what was not supplied or not recorded ('Not supplied: balance not stated', 'Documentary gap', 'Units not recorded', 11 unavailable forecast rows).
expected: PRODUCT.md:23 ('limits, gaps and refusals are explicit'); the tab's own line 'What this run could not establish, with the detail each handoff records'; AGENTS.md (missing handoff content remains an explicit gap).
actual: Gaps tab: 'Gaps 0 ... This run lists no gaps.' Financial foundation: Subordinated notes 'Not supplied: balance not stated', and 'Not supplied: synthetic' (twice). Forecast: 'Units not recorded', '11 rows have no recorded values in this view', ten lines 'the forecast inputs do not name the row and period of this line'. Downside: 'Documentary gap' on the net leverage watch level. The cause in the proof is that the canned handoffs carry no Gaps section; the reader cannot tell that, and the tab reads as a clean bill.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-004-gaps-none-vs-not-supplied.cjs
suggested_change: Either list the 'Not supplied', 'Documentary gap' and 'Units not recorded' items in the Gaps tab, or word the tab 'No gaps declared in the handoffs' and say where in-line gaps are shown.

title: Forecast notes name module codes and a tool ('CP-1', 'CP-2G', "Python's arithmetic") and use trade shorthand (PYTD, PF LTM, n.m.) outside the Evidence page.
expected: AGENTS.md:33-37 and PRODUCT.md:37 (source references, ids and run codes only on Evidence and in the trace drawer; 'text written for another module is drawn nowhere'); the reader has not read the sources and every other screen names modules by title.
actual: Four lines on Forecast: 'LTM is the last fiscal year when that is the latest period CP-1 labels...'; "Every figure is Python's arithmetic over inputs the CP-2G handoff stated..."; 'The last twelve months could not be built from the periods CP-1 prints...'; 'These columns have no recorded values: Quarter, YTD, PYTD, Fiscal year, LTM, Prior LTM, PF LTM.' The reader cannot map CP-2G to 'Forward credit model' from anything on the page.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-005-forecast-module-codes.cjs
suggested_change: Write 'Financial foundation' for CP-1 and 'the Forward credit model' for CP-2G, drop the word Python, and spell out or define LTM, PYTD, PF LTM and n.m. where they remain.

title: Forecast and Downside starting values do not tie to the reported figures on Overview and Financial foundation, and nothing beside the headline case values says so; the only disclosure is ten identical lines at the foot of the page.
expected: AGENTS.md:65 and PRODUCT.md:59 ('Exact values survive every boundary'); a reader comparing FY2024 with FY2025E expects a bridge or a stated break next to the case numbers.
actual: FY2024 revenue 2,250 (Overview, Financial foundation) against FY2025E revenue 1,050; FY2024 gross debt 1,400 against opening debt 600; net leverage 2.25x (Overview, FY2024), 1.25x (Downside control, 'LTM to 2025-03-31 as reported'), 1.23x (Forecast FY2025E). The case cards read '172.46 / 97.47 Cash proxy · FY2027E · Units not recorded'. The text above the cash flow model does not say the inputs are unlinked; ten lines 'the forecast inputs do not name the row and period of this line' sit under the table. The cause is the proof's canned inputs; the finding is that the page shows the contradiction without a flag where the numbers are read.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-006-forecast-not-tied-to-history.cjs
suggested_change: When the forecast inputs are not tied to Financial foundation, say so in one sentence above the case cards (what is not linked and what that does to the case values).

title: Evidence > Trace with no item chosen shows the same 15 handoff download buttons as Summary and no line telling the reader how to pick something to trace.
expected: docs/design/react-module-coverage.md:37 (Trace is where calculations expand and trace links land); a tab with nothing selected needs an empty state saying what it is for.
actual: Clicking the Trace tab shows (with a module filter set it shows that module's one download row) 'Handoffs / Download all handoffs / Download <module> ...' and nothing else, which is what Summary shows under 'Run evidence'. A reader who opens Trace to see how a figure was derived finds a download list and no hint that the trace appears only after using a source icon on another page.
probe: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/output/3-journeys/J3/probes/j3-007-trace-tab-no-selection.cjs
suggested_change: Show a one-line empty state ('Use the source icon beside a paragraph, row or figure to see how it was derived here') and leave the downloads where they are.

title: Overview lists 13 modules under 'Bottom line by module' while the tab says 'Modules 14'; the headline Bottom line and Key findings come from 'Committee decision', which is named only inside the trace drawer and the Limitations list.
expected: Reader standard (docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md via AGENTS.md:30-37): the reader should not have to guess which module a judgement comes from; two counts on one screen should agree or say why.
actual: Tab bar 'Modules 14'; the module list has 13 rows and no Committee decision row; the band 'Bottom line: The synthetic issuer shows one observed item.' and the card 'The synthetic issuer's cover is thin at 3.1x.' name no author. Only the drawers say 'Committee decision · Handoff line 28 / 32'. The Committee decision page's own verdict ('Final Sizing Posture: Requires More Work') is not on Overview. The finding's drawer offers only Close and Open in Evidence; no control takes the reader from a finding to the module page that wrote it.
probe: journey.md step 2 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Label the headline band and each key finding with its author module as a link, and either add the 14th row or say 'Bottom line by module (13 of 14; the committee decision is above)'.

title: The left rail's two icon links (a book, a play button) have no visible label and no tooltip, so a first-time reader must guess that they mean Library and Run activity.
expected: Reader who 'has not read the source documents' (PRODUCT.md:11); icon-only navigation needs a label or tooltip.
actual: Accessible names exist ('Library', 'Run') but nothing is drawn: no text, no title attribute, and hovering the play icon for 1.2 s showed only a grey hover tint, no tooltip. The accessible name 'Run' also differs from the page it opens, 'Run activity'.
probe: journey.md step 8 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Add a tooltip (and a visible label at widths that allow) and use 'Run activity' as the name.

title: Overview's key finding says 'cover is thin at 3.1x' directly beside a tile 'Interest coverage 4.00x +0.80x vs FY2023 better', and never says which cover measure 3.1x is.
expected: Exact values with their quantity family (AGENTS.md:65): two different covers on one screen need names.
actual: Key findings: 'The synthetic issuer's cover is thin at 3.1x.' Tile: 'Interest coverage 4.00x, better'. The Downside module calls 3.10 'All-in cover (x)' for the control case; Financial foundation's chart shows interest cover 3.20 (FY2023) and 4.00 (FY2024). A reader sees 'thin' next to 'better' with no explanation.
probe: journey.md step 2 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Name the measure in the finding ('all-in cover') or link it to the module row that defines it.

title: 'Dates to watch' and the Issuer calendar use unexplained words ('Wall', 'Cost', 'Rating', '· day', '· month') and show a 'Historical' event dated after the as-of date and a 'Scheduled' event on the as-of date.
expected: Reader who has not read the sources (PRODUCT.md:11); labels need to be understandable without the handoff.
actual: Rows read 'Synthetic note / Source readiness · Wall / Scheduled — matures / 2025-03-31 · day'; the calendar has a 2025-06 event labelled Historical when the case date is 2025-03-31, and the same four events repeat for nine modules (36 events). Nothing explains 'Wall' (maturity wall) or the precision words. Most of this is canned proof content; the unexplained vocabulary is not.
probe: journey.md step 2 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Spell out 'Maturity wall', drop the precision words or show them as a date format, and explain Historical against the as-of date.

title: Evidence > Script checks shows a badge '215' and a list in which 205 items read 'not checked', with no sentence saying what a script check is or what 'not checked' means.
expected: PRODUCT.md:23 (state limits explicitly); a count in a tab badge needs a definition for a reader who has not read the sources.
actual: Rows such as 'Legal & covenants 32 not checked', 'Security selection 1 agreed 35 not checked'. Totals: 9 agreed, 1 noted, 205 not checked. A reader can take this as 95% of the run's numbers being unverified, or as noise; the page does not say which.
probe: journey.md step 7 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Add a two-sentence explanation above the list and say what 'not checked' means (no script exists for the item, or the script was not run).

title: Opening Evidence from the Forecast Revenue chart lands on a block that prints a literal '```json' fence and a single-line machine-readable JSON object.
expected: Owner design rule 'nothing may look extracted from Markdown' (PRODUCT.md:46); Evidence may show machinery but not the Markdown fence characters.
actual: Evidence > Trace 'Forward credit model · Line 93 · Recorded forecast inputs' then 'Forecast inputs (machine-readable)' with the text '```json {"schema_version": "cpos-forecast-inputs/1", "base": {...' and a closing '```'.
probe: journey.md step 5 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Strip the fence and render the inputs as a table or a formatted code block without the backticks.

title: The forecast case is called 'Downside shock' on its card and comparison row but 'Downside case' on the cash flow table and the notes, and the Downside module calls its scenarios 'Cost shock' and 'Cost and rate shock'.
expected: One name per thing across screens (harmony rubric; control-matrix CT-045 'Choosing a forecast case').
actual: Card: 'Downside shock 97.47'. After choosing it the table header reads 'Line item | Downside case'; note 'Downside case is the stress case: a shock applied to the base-case drivers.'
probe: journey.md step 5 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Use one name ('Downside case') everywhere on Forecast.

title: 'Confidence score 89 High' appears on every module page with no scale, no definition and no sentence next to it; its trace drawer repeats 'no page / the row cites no page or register' fourteen times.
expected: PRODUCT.md:11 (reader has not read the sources) and principle 3 (findings on working pages, machinery on Evidence); a score needs its scale.
actual: The card reads '89 High'. The card's trace control is named 'Show sources for this figure'; the drawer's statement is 'Confidence inputs' (Handoff line 161) followed by 14 identical 'no page / the row cites no page or register' rows. The inputs list (Directly Sourced 8, Calculated 2, ..., Fields present 95 of 100, Source gate pass) is inside a disclosure further down; nothing says how 89 follows or what 100 would mean.
probe: journey.md step 3 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Show 'out of 100' and one sentence on what drives the score, and collapse repeated 'no page' rows in the drawer.

title: The Downside module formats the same quantity two ways ('EBITDA decline 0.1 (10%)' and 'FCF reaches zero 0.10 (10%)') and labels a drop-down 'Compare with Control (unstressed)' while it shows 'Cost shock'.
expected: Harmony rubric: one numeric format per quantity on a page; labels should name what the control chooses.
actual: 'EBITDA decline 0.1 (10%)', 'Cash-interest increase 0' (no unit), break points '0.10 (10%)', '0.15 (15%)', '0.32 (32%)'. The select under 'Compare with Control (unstressed)' offers Cost shock and Cost and rate shock, so the label reads as if the control case were being chosen.
probe: journey.md step 5 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Show 10% only, give the cash-interest increase a unit, and label the control 'Stress case to compare with the unstressed control'.

title: The tab named 'Report' opens a page titled 'Report history', the breadcrumb reads 'Library / Report' with 'Report' not a link, and the library card link '1 run' goes to the same page; a reader has to guess that 'Report' means the run history.
expected: One name per thing across screens (harmony rubric).
actual: Tab 'Report' (first of Report / Overview / Changes / Modules / Forecast / Evidence), page heading 'Report history' with one row 'Full credit assessment · As of 31 March 2025 · Finished · Open overview · What changed'. The whole report is also called 'Report' in the breadcrumb.
probe: journey.md step 8 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Name the tab 'History' (or 'Runs') and make the breadcrumb 'Library / <issuer>'.

title: Browser tab titles do not identify the module or Evidence tab (every module page reads 'Modules — <issuer> — Credit OS', every Evidence tab 'Evidence — ...'), and the Library, Run activity, Start and Run progress pages are all titled 'Credit OS'.
expected: WCAG 2.2 AA working assumption (PRODUCT.md:63): page titles describe the page.
actual: Titles read with page.title(): see the capture. A reader with several runs or modules open in tabs cannot tell them apart.
probe: journey.md step 8 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Put the module name and Evidence tab in the title, and 'Run activity', 'Start a run' and the issuer name on the other routes.

title: The header switch 'Show sources' only draws a ring around the existing trace icons; it shows no source, which is what its name promises.
expected: Labels say what the control does (design rubric).
actual: Turning it on changes the trace icons from plain to ringed (screenshot); no paragraph, figure or row gains a source line. It is not remembered after a reload; it is kept when changing tabs.
probe: journey.md step 2 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Rename to 'Highlight source icons' or make it show each item's basis line.

title: In Evidence > Summary > Handoffs, the name 'Forward credit model' is a link (to a trace entry) while every other module name in the list is plain text, with no visual difference.
expected: One kind of thing, one treatment (harmony rubric).
actual: Anchors read from the page: 'Download all handoffs', 'Download <module>' per module, and one extra anchor 'Forward credit model' pointing to '#evidence/...CP-2G.md~31b71b2e...'.
probe: journey.md step 7 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: Make the row label plain text, or give every module row the same link.

title: In the synthetic proof every trace ends 'not in inventory' or 'no page': the canned handoffs cite 'annual.txt, page 2', not the uploaded northbridge-filing.txt, so the proof never shows a trace reaching an uploaded source.
expected: AGENTS.md (synthetic scope must be labelled; a live success needs real downstream consumption): the proof cannot demonstrate 'traces to its source' end to end.
actual: Key finding drawer: 'Basis annual.txt, page 2 / annual.txt p.2 · not in inventory / the Basis file is not in the CP-0 inventory'. Leverage chart drawer: 'Basis Synthetic. / no page / the row cites no page or register' (twice). Evidence > Sources lists northbridge-credit-agreement.txt, northbridge-filing.txt and northbridge-portfolio.xlsx, each with a hash and an Open link that answers 200.
probe: journey.md step 3 (observed; a probe is required only from Medium)
suggested_change: none; the owner decides whether the proof's handoffs should cite the uploaded file names.

screen: proof.serve start with a root that holds a finished run
title: proof.serve refuses a run root that already holds files, so a finished synthetic run cannot be reopened after the service stops; the J3 brief assumed it persists.
expected: Stage 3 brief to this agent ('Run state persists in /tmp/jr/j3, so a later segment can reopen an earlier run').
actual: 'serve.py: error: the synthetic proof requires an empty, separate run root' (proof/serve.py:17-18). Each journey segment had to empty its root and run the 14 synthetic modules again (about 3 s).
probe: journey.md, Setup section (observed during setup)
suggested_change: none; a design decision of the proof (docs/react-workflow.md says 'Use a new folder').
